name: Thaddeus Claggett
stance: Sponsors HB 469 declaring AI systems nonsentient and barring AI legal personhood so liability stays with humans.

statements.text: But sophistication is not sentience. It is not personhood. AI may simulate human reason to a degree, but it cannot and must not be permitted to supplant it.
statements.outlet: Ohio House Technology and Innovation Committee (sponsor testimony)

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
